cell_decomposition.symbolic_geometry: triangle with three hot vertex symbols of physical weight 1 and three cold edge symbols of physical weight 4

uncoupled_baseline.construction: 27 Petersen [15,6,5] cycle codes plus 405 independent [4,1,4] cold-block repetition codes

symmetry: The 135 cells are intrinsic packet-coordinate objects; PSp and PGSp permute cells and induce the triangle S3 action, so every S3-invariant local code lifts to a PGSp-invariant global direct-sum code.
theorem: The 3K2,2 connection law canonically partitions all 2025 router edges into 135 fifteen-edge cross-fiber cells. Exhausting all 25 S3-invariant binary local subspaces gives the exact weighted rate-distance Pareto points (1,15),(2,10),(3,7),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1). In particular [2025,405,7]_2 is a genuine cross-fiber code and improves K*d over the simple uncoupled [2025,567,4]_2 baseline while explicitly trading rate for distance.
execution: independent reconstruction of all 2025 physical edges and exhaustive enumeration of all 2825 binary subspaces of F2^6, retaining exactly 25 S3-invariant subspaces
boundary: Exact binary-code/symmetry result. K*d is one stated comparison metric; no universal coding optimum or physical fault-tolerance threshold is claimed.
